items.name: Dirty Tricks
items.text: The ratfolk feint and trip up their foes in a 5-foot emanation, attempting a single Thievery check check and comparing the result to each target's Reflex DC. On a success, the target is Clumsy 1 (Clumsy 2 on a critical success) until they take an Interact action to remove the condition.

items.name: Poisoned Bolts
items.text: The shank squad draws hand crossbows to fire poisoned bolts in a volley. This volley is a 10-foot burst within 60 feet that deals 2d6 piercing damage and 2d6 poison damage with a DC 22 basic Reflex save save. When the shank squad is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

items.name: Shank 'Em
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The shank squad makes a coordinated attack with shivs and daggers against each enemy in a 5-foot emanation, with a DC 22 basic Reflex save save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d6 slashing damage and 1d4 precision damage

2 2d6+3 slashing damage and 2d4 precision damage

3 2d6+6 slashing damage and 3d4 precision damage
